title: At Times, Even Aquafit Can Create A Family Rift; The Ties That Bind Unravel

contact_edits.before: The song Autumn Leaves actually plays on the soundtrack that precedes and follows the performance, along with such other relevant tunes as I'll See You in My Dreams and, most poignantly jaunty at the end, We Just Couldn't Say Goodbye. Maybe these were just chosen at random as old music to suit old people. But that would be quite a coincidence. - Another Home Invasion runs through April 19 at the Tarragon Theatre. For more information, call 416-531-1827.
